about.label: about
about.lead: Hi! My name is Rodrigo Dutra.
paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineering student at the University of Brasília (UnB), currently in my fifth semester, and a member of CJR, UnB's computing junior enterprise, where I work on real projects for clients.

I'm passionate about technology and continuous learning, focused mainly on the Node.js and TypeScript ecosystem. I've built full-stack projects end to end, working with PostgreSQL, Docker, and CI/CD with GitHub Actions, along with experience in agile methods, technical documentation, and teamwork.

At CJR, besides working as a developer, I'm part of the Research and Development Center, in the Continuous Training Coordination, where I help create training tracks on topics like Docker, deployment, and CI/CD.

I've been drawn to problem-solving and technology from an early age. During my studies at the Military School of Brasília, I took part in math competitions, and today I keep developing that side through hackathons, personal projects, and algorithm study, having solved more than 130 problems on LeetCode.

I also had the chance to live in Italy for two years during my school years, where I studied Terza Media & Liceo 1 Linguistico Europeo (Indirizzo Giuridico-Economico), an experience that broadened my adaptability and my contact with different cultures. I speak Portuguese, English, and Italian.

projects.label: projects
projects.intro: A selection of what I've built, from full stack to the terminal and infrastructure.

bookshelf.description: Full stack app to manage a personal library and track reading habits, with Google Books search and Gemini-powered recommendations.

algocards.description: Flashcards for algorithms and data structures, using FSRS-6 spaced repetition to schedule reviews and prepare for technical interviews.

stockio.description: Marketplace backend covering users, stores, products, and categories, built during the CJR trainee process, with JWT auth and password recovery.

homelab.description: Self-hosted development environment on Fedora Linux, with services in Docker, a reverse proxy, monitoring, and reproducible backups.

piggyme.description: Personal finance app with income, expenses, goals, and dashboards, built as a team for the Software Development Methods course at UnB.

unitask.description: Full stack task manager with auth, a calendar, and a weekly activity chart drawn with the Canvas API, no external libraries.

budgetpro.description: Personal finance dashboard in vanilla JavaScript: income, expenses, a chart, and live BRL/USD conversion via the Frankfurter API.

atividadeDocker.description: CJR Docker track exercise: containerizing a message-board API with PostgreSQL, multi-stage images, Compose, and publishing to GHCR.

learning.description: A running log of my studies and exercises through the year, from data structures and compilers to TypeScript, NestJS, and SQL.

cinema.description: A command-line tool in Python to manage a cinema's screenings, rooms, and tickets from the terminal.

dataStructures.description: Coursework and implementations from the Data Structures 1 course at UnB, from linked lists to trees, in C.

deployCicd.description: A CJR track exercise on deployment and continuous integration and delivery, automating builds and releases with GitHub Actions.
